body:
A plan serialized by v1.x that calls `struct_update` runs incorrectly on 2.0. When it only updates existing fields, such as `struct_update(col, i := 10)`, it returns `col` unchanged without an error. When it also adds a field, such as `struct_update(col, i := 10, j := 'x')`, it fails with "INTERNAL Error: Attempted to access index 2 within vector of size 2".

v1.x resolved the field that every argument of `struct_update` writes when the function ran, by matching the aliases of the arguments against the field names of the struct, and only stored the result type. Since #26844 the fields are resolved at bind time and kept in `field_indexes` (property 101) of the bind data, which is all that execution reads. Plans written by v1.x don't have that property, so `field_indexes` deserialized as empty.

This PR rebuilds `field_indexes` from the argument aliases and the result type when it is missing, the way v1.x resolved the fields.

The added plan cases we're serialized with 1.5
Could this still be backported?
title: Keep the fields struct_update writes in plans serialized before v2.0.0
